description: DiligenceOps: submit two samples of the same API response (before and after, as JSON or its serialized string). Following the wever_data-evidence-check field analysis, the signed report lists the fields added, the fields removed, the fields whose JSON type changed and the fields whose value format changed (timestamps, numeric strings, ids, urls and more), by record-relative JSON pointer. POST /api/api-change-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

after.description: The same response from the later version, in the same form.

after_label.description: Optional name for the later sample.

before.description: One API response as a JSON object or array, or as its serialized JSON string (which also reveals duplicate keys). Up to 256 KB.

before_label.description: Optional name for the earlier sample, for example "v1, 2026-10-01".

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint URL, recorded exactly as supplied. Processing uses the submitted samples.
